name: Steal a Bird
desc:
Collect Birds, earn Cash, and protect your Birds from sneaky bird thieves!
Or... become a bird thieves yourself. 🐦👀

[How To Play]
• Buy a Bird who appears from the portal!
• Earn cash from the Birds!
• Steal Birds from other players!
• Become the player with the most worth!

🌙 Your birds keep earning even while you're offline — check back daily to grow your Birds!
🎁 Like the game, follow @Oio981 and Join the Group to unlock a FREE Legendary Bird!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
